# Missing AI

> Missing AI is a free MIT-licensed open-source checker for potential omissions in AI-generated answers. The public browser tool compares pasted requirements and answers using wording-based heuristics. Optional ChatGPT and Claude custom MCP beta tools support host-proposed semantic reviews with mechanical validation of exact answer quotes and source-reference accounting.

Canonical website: https://abdulkadirkhoujja.github.io/missing-ai/
Source repository: https://github.com/AbdulkadirKhoujja/missing-ai
License: https://github.com/AbdulkadirKhoujja/missing-ai/blob/main/LICENSE
Full guide index: https://abdulkadirkhoujja.github.io/missing-ai/guides/
Data-handling limitations: https://abdulkadirkhoujja.github.io/missing-ai/privacy.html

## Core concepts

- Compare an AI answer with the original requirements or brief.
- A source line highlighted by the web tool is a **candidate for human review**, not a verified semantic omission.
- A host AI can classify claims as covered, contradicted, not clearly mentioned or indeterminate; those semantic judgments are not independently verified by the server.
- The MCP validators check whether quotation offsets match the original supplied AI answer and whether every extracted source requirement reference is assessed.
- No tool verifies actual code implementation, grading, factual truth, legal compliance or WCAG accessibility conformance.
- Public URL import is limited to readable public HTTPS HTML/plain-text pages. Do not submit secrets, private assignments, client files, personal identifiers or sensitive information.
- The public remote MCP is a controlled unauthenticated beta, not an officially listed plugin or a general-use privacy-certified production service.
